name: After Party
source: You are invited to your ex's wedding party in a different country. You took some days off to vacations and decided to go. After a few bad moments when you are about to leave, you meet someone unexpected. - ​
translation: 你被邀请参加前任在另一个国家举行的婚礼。你请了几天假并决定去。在经历了一些糟糕的时刻后，当你准备离开时，你遇到了一个意想不到的人。-​
